truth: Summerset is the Altmer homeland and the Thalmor's heart: two bright islands of white cliffs, crystal-strewn coasts, terraced vineyards and ordered gardens, with Artaeum, the Psijics' island, half in the mist. Lineage decides a life here: kinlord houses rule cities, Sapiarchs keep learning at the Crystal Tower, the Thalmor govern from Alinor and their justiciars watch everyone, and outsiders work in harbour quarters on permits. The Altmer honour their ancestors in crystal vaults and deny that any man became a god. The sea is the danger: Maormer raid Auridon, the Sload's vents breach the coast, and hidden Daedric cults grow inside the perfect cities while Imperial-era names survive only on old maps.

summerset_isle.truth: The larger island is the most ordered land in Tamriel. Alinor's sixteen avenues radiate from the Crystal Tower's sight-line; Shimmerene is the one port where outsiders crowd into a permit quarter; Lillandril's libraries stand open to the sky; Cloudrest hangs over the sea on its mountain eyrie. Vineyards climb the downs, gryphons nest on the cliffs and the Corgrad Wastes lie salt-white inland. Under the order, kinlord houses fight the Thalmor by etiquette, Sload vents breach the south shore and a cult of the Mad God remembers a temple Arena knew.

auridon.truth: Auridon is the warmer northern island, Summerset's front door and its military front line facing the continent. Foreign ships must land at Vulkhel Guard's open quays; Firsthold sits on a tidal rock reached by a low causeway, and Skywatch crowns its hill under a great brass orrery. Maormer raiders strike the coves in every southern gale, and the Dominion marines answer from Hightide Keep. In the Banished Cells and Mehrunes' Spite, Daedric cults that the Thalmor officially deny exist are growing among disgraced scions. Auridon's people are prouder of their island's ancient guard duty than of its quiet.

artaeum.truth: Artaeum is the Psijic Order's island off Summerset, there in the mist and sometimes not in the mortal world at all. Ceporah Tower, the Grand Psijic Villa and a ruined older college stand among quiet lotus pools under the Statue of Syrabane. The Order keeps the Old Ways and dangerous relics no one else may touch; time runs strangely in its under-vaults and in the Dreaming Cave. The Thalmor covet those relics and resent an Altmer authority they cannot command. A silent boat comes for those the Ritemaster invites, and only through the standing mist.
